title: Minimum XOR Walk
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq T \leq 10^5; 2 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5; N-1 \leq M \leq 2 \times 10^5; 0 \leq K \lt 2^{30}; 1 \leq U_i \lt V_i \leq N; 0 \leq W_i \lt 2^{30}; The given graph is simple and connected.; All input values are integers.; The sum of N over all test cases in a single input is at most 2 \times 10^5.; The sum of M over all test cases in a single input is at most 2 \times 10^5.
